title: Playwright-based E2E testing
description: Learn about Playwright-based E2E testing. Master the concepts, patterns, and best practices.

data.text: **Playwright-based E2E testing** is an essential topic for senior engineers. In this lesson, you will learn the core concepts, practical applications, and common pitfalls associated with playwright-based e2e testing.

items: Understand the fundamental principles of playwright-based e2e testing
Learn practical applications and use cases
Identify common pitfalls and how to avoid them

data.text: Understanding playwright-based e2e testing is critical for building robust systems. It helps you make better architectural decisions, write cleaner code, and troubleshoot issues more effectively in production environments.
